construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Exact top-level fields: schema_version, synthetic, processing_residency, account_id, query, completed_actions, records, cdr_csv. records are discriminated subscriber/ticket/usage/chat/adjustment objects. CSV is converted into usage records before the same validation layer runs.
shared_schema.envelope: All stages consume and return the same schema_version/synthetic/status/stage/account_id/residency/query/completed_actions/records/search/journey/documents/feedback envelope. Each stage validates its predecessor and its own output.
shared_schema.record_identity: Globally unique uppercase record IDs; pseudonymous ACC account references; synthetic=true; EU or US residency equal to processing residency on every source record.
shared_schema.privacy: Consent=true and purpose=service_support required for every subscriber. Fictitious reserved phone range and synthetic IMEI markers only. Subscriber details are minimized, and phone/device/email patterns are removed before search, optional embeddings, documents, feedback and stdout. Unexpected structured fields rejected.
shared_schema.billing: Integer cent adjustments must be nonzero and contain a nonblank stated reason. Documents are proposals, never execution of credits.
shared_schema.errors: Validation or file errors produce one JSON object with status=error and process exit code 2. Success emits one JSON object with status=ok and exit code 0.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Ranked positive-score source references with validated residency; references become the journey evidence set.
Exactly two unfinished, prerequisite-validated actions and their source IDs; each generates one checked document.
Checked document source IDs define eligible support transcripts. Evidence links both original chat IDs and supporting document IDs.

behavior.semantic: Rebuilt deterministic in-memory term-frequency cosine index with telecom synonym normalization; tie-break by record ID. Optional run(data, embedding=callable) receives only redacted text strings and returns a validated finite rectangular numeric vector batch. No implicit provider or fallback call.
behavior.journey: Topic-weighted action priorities, stable tie-breaking, completed prerequisite closure, no repeated action and exactly two eligible steps. No hits or fewer than two remaining actions is an explicit validation error.
behavior.documents: General typed-record extraction, reshape into counts by kind, exact integer usage totals, ticket references and reasoned adjustment proposals; recompute to check totals and validate all source links.
behavior.feedback: Document-scoped transcript deduplication after redaction and whitespace normalization. Multi-label network/usage/billing themes, or other. Counts measure unique messages, not subscribers. Excerpts are whitespace-normalized original words truncated to 240 characters; duplicate source IDs retained.
behavior.fixtures: Clearly synthetic fictional subscriber, invented network ticket and support chat transcripts, reserved fictional phone number and non-real IMEI marker. Example usage volumes were generated with random.Random(103), drawing seconds from 1..4000 and megabytes from 1..2000 per row. Tests verify those seeded values and exercise zero/randomized volumes.
behavior.mutation: run does not mutate caller input. Individual stages advance their supplied validated envelope in place.

included: Demonstrative subscriber protection and record residency rules
excluded: Comprehensive free-text PII detection including personal names or addresses
Actual network repairs or billing execution
Unbounded files or adversarial resource exhaustion defenses

coverage: CLI success, file errors, malformed JSON and validation errors
